title: The Splintering Testimony South

features.name: the split voice
features.desc-on-touch: one testimony becomes two, becomes four. each version is true and contradicts the last. the field finally speaks all its names at once, and they do not agree.

features.name: the orchard rows
features.desc-on-touch: statements planted in straight lines, each identical, each saying something different. the corruption loves the sameness and the variation both.

features.name: the fence between versions
features.desc-on-touch: it does not divide. it connects the testimony on this side to the testimony on that side. both are standing here.

features.name: the deeper argument
features.desc-on-touch: where the south multiplies further. you can still hear the conference above, but here the versions are arguing with themselves.

inscription: the field said all its names at once and then began arguing which one was truest

file.name: Testimony_Archive_Multiple_Valid_Versions_Surgery_Adaptations_NSW.txt
file.note: accounts of the same moment that never agree: which testimony holds? all of them hold, the corruption whispers, and all of them are true
